Not long after Zhang Wanshi returned to the mountain, Qing and Crow gradually stopped visiting together. On the rare occasions they did come, the atmosphere between them was no longer the same as before. 
Though Zhang Wanshi was not perceptive in human affairs, he understood Qing and Crow well and sensed that something significant was brewing. 
He found a tri-colored stone at the heart of the lake and patiently polished it into a ring, thinking that if his junior sister and brother visited again, he might gift them this Cai Huan. 
He was not skilled in offering comfort, but upon seeing this ring, they would naturally understand his fraternal sentiments. In their youth, they had shared a dream; now, even if life's Wuchang trials separated them, they would still walk the same path together. 
Yet after that, the three never gathered again.

Amiao is the most envied—and pitied—Kitty among the local Cats.
Because it gets to eat fish every day, always full and never hungry. But also because it’s taken daily to the mysterious Miaomiao Temple to learn skills, all while its little owner keeps muttering things it can’t understand.
Oh, how Amiao wishes it could tell its little owner: "The sky will darken, bellies will growl, fish will slip away—but treasure-hunting won’t. Because if you don’t know how to find treasure, you just don’t."
